finding.title: Add the tutor point-permission assertion gamification_p1_test.dart E2E-608 Part 2 claims but never checks

evidence.quote:
'shows the permission-denied SnackBar on tap, and the point config '
          'increment button is disabled', (tester) async {

// The screen may show "no active curricula" but the Save button
        // and increment/decrement buttons are all disabled. Just assert

finding.why: The test's own name promises to verify 'the point config increment button is disabled' for a tutor with canEditPoints=false. Part 2 of the body navigates to PointConfigScreen and asserts only the screen title ('Point Settings') — no widget query checks the `+` control's disabled state and nothing is tapped-then-verified-inert. I traced the production wiring: point_config_screen.dart:241 computes `canEdit = tutorPerms == null || tutorPerms.canEditPoints`, gates `onIncrement` at line 332 and the save bar at line 346, and `tutorPerms` comes from `activeTutorPermissionsProvider`, which derives from `activeTutoredProfileSelectionProvider` — the exact provider this test overrides with canEditPoints:false. So today's code is correct, but a future regression that flips that gate would sail through this test green despite its title's explicit claim.
finding.recommendation: After navigating to PointConfigScreen in Part 2, assert the increment control's onPressed/onIncrement is null (or tap it and confirm no pending-edit / Save-bar-enabled state appears), matching the rigor Part 1 already applies to the Save Reward permission-denied check.
acceptance_criteria: E2E-608 Part 2 contains an explicit expect() on the increment control's disabled state, not just a screen-title check
Hard-coding point_config_screen.dart's canEdit to always-true makes this test fail

finding.title: Narrow the swallow-all catch in gamification_p1_test.dart's _loadMilestones test helper

evidence.quote:
} catch (_) {
    return const [];

finding.why: _loadMilestones backs the final assertion of 4 tests (E2E-605/606/607/613) that all compare SharedPreferences-persisted reward milestones against expected titles. A bare `catch (_) { return const []; }` around the JSON decode+map turns ANY exception — a genuine RewardMilestone.fromJson schema-mismatch bug, JSON corruption, a typo in the config key — into a silently-returned empty list. A real production regression here would surface only as a confusing 'expected isNotEmpty, got []' failure, with the actual exception and stack trace discarded, instead of pointing at the real defect.
finding.recommendation: Let the exception propagate (test helpers should fail loudly), or catch only the specific expected type (e.g. FormatException from jsonDecode) and rethrow anything else.
acceptance_criteria: _loadMilestones no longer has a bare `catch (_)`; either no catch, or a narrowly-typed catch that rethrows for unexpected exceptions

finding.title: Un-skip hebrew_rtl_p1_test.dart E2E-1510 — R-OB7 onboarding hardcoded-English bug is already fixed

evidence.quote: 'BUG R-OB7: onboarding profile-mode card text is hardcoded English '
title: AppLocalizations.of(context)!.childModeCardTitle,
"childModeCardTitle": "מצב ילדים",

finding.why: The file's docstring (lines 30-33) and the E2E-1510 group's skip reason claim OnboardingProfileCreationStep hardcodes English mode-card copy ('Child Mode'/'Adult Mode'/'Fun & Rewards'/'Deep & Scholarly'/'ACTIVE'/'What should we call you?'). Every one of those UI strings in the current source routes through AppLocalizations (childModeCardTitle, adultModeCardTitle, childModeCardSubtitleFunRewards, onboardingNamePrompt, pointSettingsActiveBadge, ...), and app_he.arb carries real Hebrew translations, not English placeholders — the bug is fixed. The docstring's cited copy ('Deep & Scholarly') doesn't even match the current EN string ('Focused'), showing the annotation predates a later copy change too. Because the test stays skipped, nobody is regression-testing RTL/i18n correctness for the onboarding profile step, and anyone reading the skip reason is told a bug exists that doesn't — the exact opposite of the file's own 'confirm-bug→skip contract' (contrast with E2E-1511 in the same file, which correctly marks R-IC3 FIXED once the underlying bug was resolved).
finding.recommendation: Remove the skip parameter from the E2E-1510 group, run the test to confirm it passes under he locale, and update/delete the stale R-OB7 docstring block (mirroring how R-IC3 is marked FIXED elsewhere in the same file); also close R-OB7 in docs/planning/e2e-test-suite-plan.md's risk register.
acceptance_criteria: test/e2e/journeys/hebrew_rtl_p1_test.dart E2E-1510 group runs unskipped and passes.
R-OB7 row in docs/planning/e2e-test-suite-plan.md marked fixed or removed.
